tiers.name: Mechanized Infantry
tiers.effect: Unlocks Armor unit (3 atk, 1 def, 2 movement, costs 4 gold + 2 iron)

tiers.name: Precision Strike
tiers.effect: Unlocks Artillery unit (4 atk, 1 def, 1 movement, costs 5 gold + 3 iron). Attacks ignore fortification bonus.

tiers.name: Combined Arms Doctrine
tiers.effect: All units get +1 attack. Units with XP gain +1 defense. Armor gains +1 movement.

tiers.name: Trade Networks
tiers.effect: Coastal territories produce +1 gold per turn. Trade deals yield 20% bonus resources.

tiers.name: Central Banking
tiers.effect: Earn 10% interest on gold each turn (rounded down). Recruitment costs reduced by 1 gold.

tiers.name: Economic Warfare
tiers.effect: Can impose sanctions: target faction loses 3 gold per turn for 3 turns. Sanctioned faction cannot trade.

tiers.name: Signals Intelligence
tiers.effect: Spy action costs 1 influence instead of 2. Reveals enemy orders for 2 turns.

tiers.name: Covert Operations
tiers.effect: New action: sabotage. Destroy 1 fortification or steal 3 resources for 3 influence.

tiers.name: Information Warfare
tiers.effect: New action: false_flag. Make an attack appear to come from another faction. Costs 5 influence. Can destabilize alliances.

tiers.name: Uranium Enrichment
tiers.effect: Enables 'build_nuke' action. Warheads cost 10 gold + 5 uranium each. Can only strike adjacent territories.

tiers.name: ICBM Technology
tiers.effect: Nukes can hit ANY territory globally (intercontinental ballistic missiles). Warhead cost reduced to 8 gold + 3 uranium.

tiers.name: Second Strike / MAD
tiers.effect: Mutually Assured Destruction: if nuked, automatically launch retaliatory nuke at attacker's territory. Other factions lose 5 influence when you build a nuke (deterrence).
